title: Nondestructive Monitoring of Degradable Scaffold-Based Tissue-Engineered Blood Vessel Development Using Optical Coherence Tomography
protocol: Sew PGA mesh around silicone tubing using 5-0 suture.
Attach polytetrafluoroethylene (ePTFE) to each end of PGA mesh using 4-0 suture, overlapping by 2 mm.
Dip PGA scaffolds in 1 mol/L NaOH for 1 minute.
Soak PGA scaffolds with tissue culture grade water three times, each for 2 minutes.
Gently pat dry the scaffold with a tissue paper after each soaking.
Dry up the scaffolds in a hood with a blower for 1 hour.
Soak the bioreactor and its components in a 95% ethanol tank for 2 hours.
Assemble PGA scaffolds into the side-arms of the bioreactor using connectors.
Connect another PGA scaffold to the bioreactor in the same manner.
Fit ePTFE to bioreactor lips by tightening with 4-0 sutures.
Place the assembled bioreactor back into a 95% ethanol tank for 1 hour.
Dry up the bioreactor overnight in a hood with blower on.
Isolate HUASMCs from human umbilical arteries by standard explant techniques.
Expand and maintain cells in smooth muscle cell growth medium.
Seed HUASMCs at a concentration of 5×10^6 cells/mL onto PGA scaffolds.
Place a stir bar (1.5 cm length) in the bioreactor.
Insert one feeding tube (5 mm diameter, 15 cm length) and three short tubing segments (5 mm diameter, 7 cm length) for gas exchange through the silicone stopper lid.
Attach PTFE 0.22 µm filters to each air change tube and one heparin cap to the feeding tube.
Adjust the stir bar with a stirring speed of 13 rounds per minute.
Assemble the glass bioreactor, silicone stopper lid, and PGA scaffold into the culture system.
Allow HUASMCs to adhere for 45 min by leaning the bioreactor every 15 min to the left and right.
Seal reactor ports and joints with paraffin film.
Connect the Luo-Ye pump, PBS bag, driver, and biocompatible tubes as the perfusion system.
Open the drive to fill the tubes with PBS.
Place the overall bioreactor in a humidified incubator with 5% CO2 at 37 °C.
Fill the culture chamber with 450 mL of HUASMCs culture medium.
Press the stop button and turn off the power of the drive device.
Grow seeded scaffolds under static culture for one week.
Change the culture medium every 3-4 days by aspirating half of the old medium through the feeding tube.
Refill the reactor with an equivalent amount of fresh culture medium.
Pump fluids in the PBS bag to circulate through biocompatible tubes and back to the bag.
Open the power of the driver and regulate pump setting with a frequency of 60 beats per minute.
Set the output systolic pressure to 120 mmHg.
Adjust mechanical parameters according to tissue engineering vascular culture needs.
Click the run button to start the perfusion system.
Provide fixed pulsatile stimulation to vessels for 3 weeks after one week of static culture by pressurizing biocompatible tubes iteratively.
Turn on the power switch and open image capture software.
Connect the fiber optic imaging catheter to the drive-motor and optical controller (DOC) with catheter automatic retreat function.
Set parameters of image acquisition rate to 10 frames per second with an automatic pullback speed of 10 mm/s.
Attach imaging catheter to Y-junction via heparin cap with a 18G needle.
Place the catheter into the silicone tube.
Identify the suture tightness of PGA mesh before loading PGA scaffold onto the bioreactor.
Place the catheter tip over the region of interest.
Adjust the pullback device and check for image quality.
Acquire images at 1, 4, 7, 10, 14, 17, 21, 28 days in culture for each individual TEBV.
Save sequentially with real-time observation of TEBV microstructure, including surface morphology, internal structure and composition.
Repeat the measurement three times to get reliable measurements of engineered vessels.
Capture a series of images throughout testing using image capture software.
Use image analysis software to measure TEBV wall thickness.
Select the image to be analyzed.
Click the tracking tool to identify the inner side of TEBV by the software automatically.
Manually sketch the outer side of TEBV.
Repeat the measurement five times to get reliable measurements of the constructs.
The OCT analysis was performed by two independent investigators blinded to obtained information.
Open the silicone stopper lid placed over the bioreactor when the culture is finished.
Discard the culture medium.
Loosen ePTFE from bioreactor lips and cut the silicone tubes from the outer side of ePTFE with scissors.
Harvest TEBVs from the bioreactor.
Cut TEBVs into sections for scanning electron microscopy examination.
Take out the rest of TEBVs and cut into 4 µm thick sections.
Pull out the supporting silicone tube and fix sections with 4% paraformaldehyde.
Perform routine histological staining of Masson's trichrome and Sirius red to examine the morphology of collagen and PGA.
Observe histologic samples with Sirius red staining by a polarized microscope.
Quantify PGA remnants based on birefringence in the cross-sectional area.
